size: outline 72.61 × 170 mm; the standard class is 100 × 100 mm or smaller; lands in larger than 100 × 100 mm: priced as "Engineering fee" plus a "Board" line that grows with area (source: quote, production-time, dimensions, read 2026-10-18)

through-hole: 14 through-hole parts to assemble (FAN3, SW1, J6, FAN1, SW2, J1, J3, J4, SW3, FAN2, FAN5, D1, +2 more; 84 plated holes); the standard is surface mount only; either tier, wave soldering: priced per solder joint ("Manual Assembly") plus a hand-soldering labour fee per order; "available under both the Economic and Standard PCBA"; no feeder-loading fee; "+ 1 more day" (source: pcba-capabilities, pcba-price, pcba-faqs, blog-pcba-cost, castellated, read 2026-10-18)
notes: on the standard tier: vias smallest via 0.3 mm hole, 0.5 mm diameter (0.3mm/(0.4/0.45mm)); smallest hole 0.3 mm (0.15 mm is the smallest standard drill); single-sided placement (121 parts on F.Cu); 1.6062 mm thick

not in the files: copper weight, surface finish (HASL, ENIG, OSP), board thickness beyond the stackup figure, colour, quantity, via covering and plating method, gold fingers, press-fit holes, blind slots, backdrill, outline tolerance, panelisation (mouse bites, V-cut); the quote page prices those
JLCPCB assembles a minimum of 2 boards; order spares (§13)

Hand-drawn power loops, a human look at every autorouted trace (§11)
